intent: Show me the walking distance from nearby hotels to Pittsburgh airport that take at most 3 minutes?

submission.answer: None of the nearby hotels qualify. The three hotels found near Pittsburgh International Airport (Sheraton Pittsburgh Airport Hotel; DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Pittsburgh Airport, Beers School Road; Sonesta Simply Suites Pittsburgh Airport, 100 Chauvet Drive) are all located in Moon Township / North Fayette Township, each several hundred metres to over a kilometre from the airport terminals. A 3-minute walk covers roughly 220–250 m, so no nearby hotel is reachable from the airport in a walking time of 3 minutes or less. The OpenStreetMap walking-directions (OSRM Foot) page did not render a computed route/distance to verify exact figures for these candidates, but none of them is within the ~250 m radius that a 3-minute walk would allow.
